items.source: Contract to stream request body content to an OutputStream. In some HTTP client libraries this is only possible indirectly through a callback mechanism.
items.translation: 将合同流式传输请求体内容到 OutputStream。在某些 HTTP 客户端库中，这只能通过回调机制间接实现。

items.source: Write this body to the given OutputStream.
items.translation: 将此内容写入指定的OutputStream。

items.source: Indicates whether this body is capable of writing its data more than once. The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 指示此流是否能够将数据写入多次。写入数据。默认实现返回false。

items.source: Indicates whether this body is capable of writing its data more than once.
items.translation: 指示此流是否能够将数据写入多次。

items.source: true if this body can be written repeatedly, false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示此主体可以重复写入，否则为 false。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: outputStream - the output stream to write to
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
